baseline.residue: Five x87 dot-product instruction differences; original bank .9438 metadata used a different metric.

independent_evidence.wb_dot: this.x*rhs.x + this.y*rhs.y + this.z*rhs.z, const pointer/reference argument; assertions check initialization
independent_evidence.native_dot: fld delta.y; fmul st(1) retaining Sin; fld delta.x; fmul facing.x; add XY; add delta.z*0; discard retained Sin
independent_evidence.rich_header: 1762 C++ objects identify build3077 and three identify4035; this does not identify the compiler for this particular function

diagnostic_progress.result: All x87 operations and their operands are native; three independent SSE theta load/multiply/store instructions are scheduled differently. Not a win and not an overall fitness improvement.
diagnostic_progress.mechanism: Adding the known-zero planar facing.z to delta.x/delta.y changes memory-multiply folding to register operands. This is diagnostic scaffolding, not a proposed production body.

visibility.observation: With both visible GetLength and Normalize definitions, the caller uses x87 projection. Hiding either chain member instead produces SSE XY arithmetic and a different extent.
visibility.interpretation: Consistent with the compiler proving that Normalize/GetLength do not let the delta address escape; exact compiler-internal cause is not established.
visibility.inert: Definition order, faithful length/normalization source variants, and visible authentic Sin/Cos bodies do not close the residue.
